_comment: Ties emulator control ids to the panel art. Each value is the id of the
<tspan> in panel/Fox-Tail.svg whose text is that control's label. The SVG
is the source of truth for label text: the emulator reads labels from it,
and a rename rewrites the tspan (matched by id) then re-renders the PNG.
Renaming by tspan id (not text) avoids the duplicate-label ambiguity
(e.g. TIME/SPREAD/FEEDBACK appear in both the knob row and the jack row).

pots._note: Pots 1-3 are global controls with their own SVG labels, listed in 'labels'. The rest share the group label bracket, and their name is '<group> <column>' with the column taken from the slider label.

switches._note: Each switch has two state labels indexed by CONTROL VALUE: [value 0, value 1]. That is NOT panel order — on this hardware both switches read 1 when UP, so index 1 is the upper legend and index 0 the lower. switch1 = left (0 CLUSTER / 1 SHEPARD), switch2 = right (0 DARK / 1 BRIGHT).

cvInputs._note: Slider CVs have no own SVG label -> '<slider label> CV'. Param CVs and the gate use the bottom jack labels.
